title: Business Hours & Operations
content: Our support team is available Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. On weekends, emergency support is available for critical server outages.

title: Account Setup & Team Invitations
content: To set up a new account or invite team members to your organization, navigate to Admin Settings -> User Management -> Invite User. Enter their email address and select their assigned role.

title: Refund Policy & Billing Queries
content: Refund requests are processed within 5 to 7 business days under our 30-day satisfaction guarantee. To request a refund, please specify your order or invoice number in your message.

title: Password Reset & Login Assistance
content: If you forgot your password, click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page and enter your registered email address. You will receive a secure password reset link valid for 24 hours.
